title: RosterAttemptsResponse
description: Attempt history of a roster job, oldest attempt first.

rosterId.description: Identifier of the roster job the history belongs to.

currentAttemptNumber.description: Attempt the job is currently on. Null when the job predates the attempt ledger, meaning no history was recorded for it.

attempts.description: Finished attempts held in the ledger, oldest first.

olderAttemptsAvailable.description: True when attempts exist beyond the ones listed here, because the ledger evicted them.

attemptsTruncated.description: Number of attempts evicted from the ledger. Zero when none were.

RosterAttemptEntry.description: One finished attempt of a roster job.

filename.description: Name of the file uploaded for the attempt.

status.description: Roster status the attempt finished in.

attemptEndedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant the attempt finished at.

captured.description: Whether the attempt's rows were captured to long-term history.
